name: Bouncing Caps
description: A wave of capital letters bounces along the text.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text.toLowerCase(),o="",pos=(env.absTime*p.speed)%Math.max(t.length,1); for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var dd=Math.abs(i-pos); o += (dd<p.width) ? t.charAt(i).toUpperCase() : t.charAt(i); } el.text=o; return el; }
